metadata.description: Sparse install: baseline_4node_6x4m with node-bedroom-se removed, so only 3 nodes cover the same ceiling-mounted 6m x 4m two-room layout, device carried at 1.0m. Same geometry, bounds, rooms and tracks as baseline_4node_6x4m so the numbers are directly comparable to it. Three ranges cannot resolve the z mirror of an unbounded 3D solve, which is why MultiFloorMultilateralizer.MinimumReadings = 4 reports no fix here; that row is pinned in the baseline on purpose.
